TradeSetup.label: Trade Setup
TradeSetup.description: Speed up the initialization of a trade.

ThingFilterToggle.label: Thing Filter Toggle
ThingFilterToggle.description: Collapse redundant change-callback firings when a storage filter toggles a whole category. Fixes potential freezes on large categories in linked storage groups.

WildAnimalFoodSearch.label: Wild Animal Food Search
WildAnimalFoodSearch.description: Cache short-lived failed wild animal food searches. Food search profiling stays active regardless of this setting.

WildAnimalFoodSearchCacheTtl.label: Cache lifetime
WildAnimalFoodSearchCacheTtl.description: How long (in real seconds) a failed wild animal food search is remembered before it is allowed to retry. Longer values increase reuse but make wild animals slower to react to newly available food.

WildAnimalFoodSearchStarvingCacheTtl.label: Starving cache lifetime
WildAnimalFoodSearchStarvingCacheTtl.description: Shorter cache lifetime (in real seconds) used when the search was marked desperate. Desperate searches retry sooner because a starving animal is more likely to find food after a small change.
